INSTANT · ON-DEVICE AI The file is a compilation of provisions from the United States Constitution (1787) in its seven Articles and four Sections. Its main points are: Representatives are elected every second Year, Senators serve six Years each with one vote per Senator; Officers are chosen by the Senate for the absence of the Vice-President or when exercising their office, and have sole power to try Impeachments; The President must approve all bills presented by Congress; a bill passes only after two-thirds agreement on its merits in both Houses (after being sent for reconsideration); if the President objects to a bill within ten days, it becomes law unless prevented from return. No new States may be formed or erected without consent of their Legislatures. Summary of all 9 pages. INSTANT can miss or mix up details of a long file; FAST summarizes files better.
